roster_ideas.title: Add the Minnesota Vikings D/ST off waivers
roster_ideas.text: Your DST spot is empty. Nobody in the league owns the Minnesota Vikings, FantasyPros' number one defense the rest of the way, so you can have the best unit in the building for the price of a waiver claim. Grab them before somebody else notices the fire sale.

advice_cards.title: Jadarian Price and Jacory Croskey-Merritt are now on IR
advice_cards.text: FantasyPros just put two of your running backs on IR in the same breath, which is either brutal luck or proof you built this bench like running backs were going out of stock. Both were buried deep enough that your lineup doesn't blink. Decide if either's worth the roster spot while they heal.

advice_cards.title: Kyle Monangai is now listed questionable
advice_cards.text: FantasyPros has Kyle Monangai questionable with a thumb injury, the most bench-running-back injury a bench running back has ever had. He's on your bench, so nothing changes, but somewhere a trainer wrote 'thumb' on a clipboard with a completely straight face.

roster_ideas.title: Add Chris Boswell off waivers
roster_ideas.text: Cameron Dicker fell out of FantasyPros' top 27 kickers. Chris Boswell, unowned leaguewide, ranks fourth the rest of the way, a free upgrade at your worst position and the rarest trade the waiver wire ever makes.

advice_cards.title: Alec Pierce is now on IR
advice_cards.text: FantasyPros has Alec Pierce on injured reserve, which barely registers in a receiver room this deep. You have more wideouts than attention span. Lineup's fine.

advice_cards.title: Jalen Hurts is now on IR
advice_cards.text: FantasyPros has Jalen Hurts on injured reserve with a calf injury, so Brock Purdy steps in at QB from your bench while we hope for a quick recovery.

advice_cards.title: Terry McLaurin is now listed out
advice_cards.text: FantasyPros has Terry McLaurin listed out this week. Chris Olave, Parker Washington, Brian Thomas Jr. and Deebo Samuel Sr. are all standing by, a receiver room most teams would trade for. Start one of the four in his place.

advice_cards.title: Davante Adams is listed out
advice_cards.text: FantasyPros has Davante Adams out with a hamstring injury, and your receiver room shrugged. DeVonta Smith, Tetairoa McMillan and Mike Evans are all healthy and ready to pretend this never happened.

roster_ideas.title: Add Dallas Goedert off waivers
roster_ideas.text: Brock Bowers is your only tight end, which means one tweak away from a bye week of zeros. Nobody in the league owns Dallas Goedert, a top-15 tight end by FantasyPros' own math. Cheap insurance.

advice_cards.title: A.J. Brown is listed questionable
advice_cards.text: FantasyPros has A.J. Brown questionable with an ankle injury after a limited practice, the fantasy equivalent of a 'fine, I'm fine' text. Drake London and Garrett Wilson are healthy insurance if he sits. Check back before lineups lock and try not to doomscroll the injury report.

roster_ideas.title: Add Wan'Dale Robinson off waivers
roster_ideas.text: Michael Pittman Jr. is still on IR, and somehow wide receiver is still your worst group despite rostering seven of them. Nobody in the league owns Wan'Dale Robinson, a top-40 receiver by FantasyPros' own numbers.

advice_cards.title: Romeo Doubs and Jonathon Brooks are now on IR
advice_cards.text: FantasyPros has both Romeo Doubs and Jonathon Brooks on injured reserve this week, rough for them and a complete non-event for your lineup, since they were buried behind better options anyway. Bench depth, proving its worth by doing absolutely nothing.

advice_cards.title: Travis Etienne Jr. is now on IR
advice_cards.text: FantasyPros has Travis Etienne Jr. on injured reserve, filed neatly behind Derrick Henry, Jeremiyah Love and a running back room that apparently never stops growing.

lineup:B:4431459:w5.title: Mostly the right calls, a few bench regrets
lineup:B:4431459:w5.text: Your Week 5 miss was Harold Fannin Jr. at tight end while Tyler Warren had the big game on your bench. It's the one real stain on a sharp record. Warren's big week arrived on the bench, which is the loneliest place to score.

pos:RB1:WR8.title: Running back is carrying this team
pos:RB1:WR8.text: Your running backs rank first in the league and your wide receivers rank last, so a receiver pickup helps most. Wan'Dale Robinson is free, per FantasyPros. Your running backs have the whole team on their backs. Send reinforcements.

proj:over:4569987:4870795.title: Your starters are beating ESPN's guesses
proj:over:4569987:4870795.text: Jaylen Warren keeps beating his projection while Makai Lemon keeps falling short of his. Keep Warren locked in and give Lemon time. ESPN's number for Warren is more of a first draft.

lineup:C:4432665:w3.title: The bench keeps getting the good weeks
lineup:C:4432665:w3.text: Your Week 3 miss was Dalton Schultz at tight end while Brock Bowers had the big game on your bench. The scoreboard never heard about it.

proj:over:4685472:4685382.text: Tetairoa McMillan keeps beating his projection while Omarion Hampton keeps falling short of his. Keep both in the lineup. McMillan is outplaying the spreadsheet and Hampton still has time to catch up with it.

pos:WR1:K8.title: Wide receiver is carrying this team
pos:WR1:K8.text: Your wide receivers rank first in the league and your kicker ranks last, so a free-agent kicker is the cheapest upgrade you have. You'll need one in Week 7 anyway, with the Chargers on a bye. Elite receivers and a bottom-of-the-league kicker is the most fixable imbalance in fantasy.

proj:over:4567048:4360248.title: Your starters are beating ESPN's guesses
proj:over:4567048:4360248.text: Kenneth Walker III keeps beating his projection while Kyle Pitts Sr. keeps falling short of his. Keep riding Walker. He's the rare player who reads ESPN's number and says cute.

lineup:C:4426354:w5.text: Your Week 5 miss was Michael Wilson in the lineup while George Pickens had the big game on your bench. Check your depth chart twice before locking in. Pickens put on a show for an audience of bench.

pos:K1:FLEX7.text: Your kickers rank first in the league and your flex spot, the wild-card slot, ranks seventh. Woody Marks is a free agent who fits flex and doubles as insurance for David Montgomery, per FantasyPros. When your kicker is your MVP, the flex spot deserves a raise.

proj:under:4567104:4035538.title: ESPN keeps overrating your starters
proj:under:4567104:4035538.text: Will Reichard keeps beating his projection while David Montgomery keeps falling short of his, so treat Montgomery's number with suspicion until his injury clears. Reichard doing the heavy lifting is not a sentence anyone expects.

lineup:D:4248528:w1.text: Your Week 1 miss was Quinshon Judkins at flex while Christian Watson had the big game on your bench. Yes, Watson again. Big numbers, wrong seat.

pos:TE1:RB7.title: Tight end is carrying this team
pos:TE1:RB7.text: Tight end is your best position and running back ranks seventh, so depth there matters most, especially with Saquon Barkley questionable. Trey McBride is quietly running a one-man tight end empire.

proj:under:4248528:3929630.text: Christian Watson keeps beating his projection while Saquon Barkley keeps coming up short of his. Trust the production, not the spreadsheet. ESPN will catch up eventually. Watson won't wait.

lineup:C:4431299:w4.text: Your Week 4 miss was Rashee Rice in the lineup while Rome Odunze had a real game on your bench. Rice's zero counted. Odunze's real game sat.
